<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="pNr1R5Flft1eS0vm6Rm5"> <mxGraphModel dx="1247" dy="317" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%%
classDiagram
 direction TB

 %% ==========================================
 %% 1. USER & IDENTITY
 %% ==========================================
 class Person {
 <<abstract>>
 -id: Long
 -name: String
 -phone: String
 -address: String
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 }

 class Employee {
 -employeeCode: String
 -salary: BigDecimal
 -status: EmployeeStatus
 +createOrder(): Order
 +createReceipt(): Receipt
 +createWarrantyCard(): WarrantyCard
 }

 class Customer {
 -email: String
 }

 class Account {
 -accountId: Long
 -username: String
 -password: String
 -employee: Employee
 -role: Role
 -status: AccountStatus
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +login(): boolean
 +changePassword(newPassword: String): boolean
 }

 class Role {
 <<enumeration>>
 +STAFF
 +MANAGER
 +ADMIN
 }

 class AccountStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +LOCKED
 +DISABLED
 }

 class EmployeeStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +ON_LEAVE
 +RESIGNED
 }

 Person <|-- Employee
 Person <|-- Customer
 Employee \"1\" <-- \"1\" Account : belong

 %% ==========================================
 %% 2. CATALOG & INVENTORY
 %% ==========================================
 class Category {
 -categoryId: Long
 -categoryName: String
 -description: String
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 }

 class Product {
 -productId: Long
 -category: Category
 -productCode: String
 -productName: String
 -brand: String
 -description: String
 -sellingPrice: BigDecimal
 -stockQuantity: int
 -unit: String
 -status: ProductStatus
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +updatePrice(newPrice: BigDecimal): void
 +updateStock(quantity: int): void
 +isAvailable(): boolean
 }

 class ProductStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +INACTIVE
 +OUT_OF_STOCK
 +DISCONTINUED
 }

 class Serial {
 -serialId: Long
 -serialNumber: String
 -status: SerialStatus
 -importedDate: LocalDate
 -soldDate: LocalDate
 +markSold(): void
 +markInStock(): void
 +isAvailable(): boolean
 }

 class SerialStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +IN_STOCK
 +SOLD
 +WARRANTY
 +RETURNED
 +DEFECTIVE
 }

 Category \"1\" o-- \"0..*\" Product : contains
 Product \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" Serial : contains

 %% ==========================================
 %% 3. SUPPLIER & RECEIPT
 %% ==========================================
 class Supplier {
 -supplierId: Long
 -supplierName: String
 -phone: String
 -email: String
 -address: String
 -status: SupplierStatus
 }

 class SupplierStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +INACTIVE
 }

 class Receipt {
 -receiptId: Long
 -status: ReceiptStatus
 -totalAmount: BigDecimal
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +calculateTotal(): BigDecimal
 +confirm(): void
 +cancel(): void
 }

 class ReceiptItem {
 -receiptItemId: Long
 -product: Product
 -quantity: int
 -unitCost: BigDecimal
 -manufacturingDate: LocalDate
 -warrantyMonths: int
 +calculateSubtotal(): BigDecimal
 }

 class ReceiptStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +DRAFT
 +COMPLETED
 +CANCELLED
 }

 Supplier \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Receipt : supplies
 Employee \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Receipt : creates
 Receipt \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ReceiptItem : details
 Product \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" ReceiptItem : refers
 ReceiptItem \"1\" --> \"1..*\" Serial : generates

 %% ==========================================
 %% 4. SALES & ORDER
 %% ==========================================
 class Order {
 -orderId: Long
 -status: OrderStatus
 -customer: Customer
 -coupon: Coupon
 -subtotal: BigDecimal
 -discountAmount: BigDecimal
 -totalAmount: BigDecimal
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +addItem(item: OrderItem): void
 +removeItem(itemId: Long): void
 +calculateTotal(): BigDecimal
 +applyCoupon(coupon: Coupon): boolean
 +confirm(): void
 +cancel(): void
 }

 class OrderItem {
 -orderItemId: Long
 -product: Product
 -quantity: int
 -originalPrice: BigDecimal
 -unitPrice: BigDecimal
 -subtotal: BigDecimal
 +calculateSubtotal(): BigDecimal
 }

 class OrderStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +DRAFT
 +CONFIRMED
 +PAID
 +COMPLETED
 +CANCELLED
 }

 Customer \"0..1\" --> \"0..*\" Order : places
 Employee \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Order : processes
 Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem : includes
 Product \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" OrderItem : refers
 OrderItem \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Serial : allocates

 %% ==========================================
 %% 5. PROMOTION & PAYMENT
 %% ==========================================
 class Coupon {
 -couponId: Long
 -code: String
 -discountType: DiscountType
 -discountValue: BigDecimal
 -maxDiscount: BigDecimal
 -minimumOrder: BigDecimal
 -startAt: LocalDateTime
 -endAt: LocalDateTime
 -usageLimit: int
 -status: CouponStatus
 +isValid(): boolean
 +calculateDiscount(orderTotal: BigDecimal): BigDecimal
 }

 class DiscountType {
 <<enumeration>>
 +PERCENTAGE
 +FIXED_AMOUNT
 }

 class CouponStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +INACTIVE
 +EXPIRED
 }

 class Payment {
 -paymentId: Long
 -method: PaymentMethod
 -status: PaymentStatus
 -amount: BigDecimal
 -transactionCode: String
 -paidAt: LocalDateTime
 +process(): boolean
 +markPaid(): void
 +markFailed(): void
 }

 class PaymentMethod {
 <<enumeration>>
 +CASH
 +BANK_TRANSFER
 +VNPAY
 }

 class PaymentStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +PENDING
 +PAID
 +FAILED
 +REFUNDED
 }

 Coupon \"0..1\" <-- \"0..*\" Order : applies
 Order \"1\" -- \"0..1\" Payment : settles

 %% ==========================================
 %% 6. WARRANTY
 %% ==========================================
 class WarrantyCard {
 -warrantyId: Long
 -startDate: LocalDate
 -endDate: LocalDate
 -status: WarrantyStatus
 +isValid(): boolean
 +activate(): void
 +expire(): void
 }

 class WarrantyClaim {
 -claimId: Long
 -warrantyCard: WarrantyCard
 -issueDescription: String
 -technicianNote: String
 -status: WarrantyClaimStatus
 -receivedAt: LocalDateTime
 -completedAt: LocalDateTime
 -returnedAt: LocalDateTime
 +receive(): void
 +startRepair(): void
 +complete(): void
 +returnProduct(): void
 }

 class WarrantyStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +EXPIRED
 +VOID
 }

 class WarrantyClaimStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +RECEIVED
 +CHECKING
 +REPAIRING
 +COMPLETED
 +RETURNED
 +REJECTED
 }

 Serial \"1\" -- \"0..1\" WarrantyCard : activates
 WarrantyCard \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" WarrantyClaim : logs
 Employee \"1\" --> \"0..*\" WarrantyClaim : inspects",

 %% ==========================================
 %% 1. USER & IDENTITY
 %% ==========================================
 class Person {
 <<abstract>>

 -id: Long
 -name: String
 -phone: String
 -address: String
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 }

 class Employee {
 -employeeCode: String
 -salary: BigDecimal
 -status: EmployeeStatus
 }

 class Customer {
 -email: String
 }

 class Account {
 -accountId: Long
 -username: String
 -password: String
 -role: Role
 -status: AccountStatus
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +login(): boolean
 +changePassword(newPassword: String): boolean
 +lock(): void
 +unlock(): void
 }

 class Role {
 <<enumeration>>

 +STAFF
 +MANAGER
 +ADMIN
 }

 class AccountStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +ACTIVE
 +LOCKED
 +DISABLED
 }

 Person <|-- Employee
 Person <|-- Customer
 Employee \"1\" -- \"1\" Account : owns

 %% ==========================================
 %% 2. CATALOG & INVENTORY
 %% ==========================================
 class Category {
 -categoryId: Long
 -categoryName: String
 -description: String
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 }

 class Product {
 -productId: Long
 -productCode: String
 -productName: String
 -brand: String
 -description: String
 -sellingPrice: BigDecimal
 -stockQuantity: int
 -warrantyMonths: int
 -unit: String
 -status: ProductStatus
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +updatePrice(newPrice: BigDecimal): void
 +updateStock(quantity: int): void
 +isAvailable(): boolean
 }

 class ProductStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +ACTIVE
 +INACTIVE
 +OUT_OF_STOCK
 +DISCONTINUED
 }

 class Serial {
 -serialId: Long
 -serialNumber: String
 -status: SerialStatus
 -importedDate: LocalDate
 -soldDate: LocalDate
 +markSold(): void
 +markInStock(): void
 +isAvailable(): boolean
 }

 class SerialStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +IN_STOCK
 +SOLD
 +WARRANTY
 +RETURNED
 +DEFECTIVE
 }

 Category \"1\" o-- \"0..*\" Product : contains
 Product \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" Serial : tracks

 %% ==========================================
 %% 3. SUPPLIER & RECEIPT
 %% ==========================================
 class Supplier {
 -supplierId: Long
 -supplierName: String
 -phone: String
 -email: String
 -address: String
 -status: SupplierStatus
 }

 class SupplierStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 +ACTIVE
 +INACTIVE
 }

 class Receipt {
 -receiptId: Long
 -status: ReceiptStatus
 -totalAmount: BigDecimal
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +calculateTotal(): BigDecimal
 +confirm(): void
 +cancel(): void
 }

 class ReceiptItem {
 -receiptItemId: Long
 -quantity: int
 -unitCost: BigDecimal
 -manufacturingDate: LocalDate
 -warrantyMonths: int
 +calculateSubtotal(): BigDecimal
 }

 class ReceiptStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +DRAFT
 +COMPLETED
 +CANCELLED
 }

 Supplier \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Receipt : supplies
 Employee \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Receipt : creates
 Receipt \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ReceiptItem : details
 Product \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" ReceiptItem : refers
 ReceiptItem \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Serial : generates

 %% ==========================================
 %% 4. SALES & ORDER
 %% ==========================================
 class Order {
 -orderId: Long
 -status: OrderStatus
 -subtotal: BigDecimal
 -discountAmount: BigDecimal
 -totalAmount: BigDecimal
 -createdAt: LocalDateTime
 -updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 +addItem(item: OrderItem): void
 +removeItem(itemId: Long): void
 +calculateTotal(): BigDecimal
 +applyCoupon(coupon: Coupon): boolean
 +confirm(): void
 +cancel(): void
 }

 class OrderItem {
 -orderItemId: Long
 -quantity: int
 -originalPrice: BigDecimal
 -unitPrice: BigDecimal
 -subtotal: BigDecimal
 +calculateSubtotal(): BigDecimal
 }

 class OrderStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +DRAFT
 +CONFIRMED
 +PAID
 +COMPLETED
 +CANCELLED
 }

 Customer \"0..1\" --> \"0..*\" Order : places
 Employee \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Order : processes
 Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem : includes
 Product \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" OrderItem : refers
 OrderItem \"0..1\" --> \"0..*\" Serial : allocates

 %% ==========================================
 %% 5. PROMOTION & PAYMENT
 %% ==========================================
 class Coupon {
 -couponId: Long
 -code: String
 -discountType: DiscountType
 -discountValue: BigDecimal
 -maxDiscount: BigDecimal
 -minimumOrder: BigDecimal
 -startAt: LocalDateTime
 -endAt: LocalDateTime
 -usageLimit: int
 -status: CouponStatus
 +isValid(): boolean
 +calculateDiscount(orderTotal: BigDecimal): BigDecimal
 }

 class DiscountType {
 <<enumeration>>

 +PERCENTAGE
 +FIXED_AMOUNT
 }

 class CouponStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +ACTIVE
 +INACTIVE
 +EXPIRED
 }

 class Payment {
 -paymentId: Long
 -method: PaymentMethod
 -status: PaymentStatus
 -amount: BigDecimal
 -transactionCode: String

 +process(): boolean
 +markPaid(): void
 +markFailed(): void
 }

 class PaymentMethod {
 <<enumeration>>

 +CASH
 +BANK_TRANSFER
 +VNPAY
 }

 class PaymentStatus {
 <<enumeration>>

 +PENDING
 +PAID
 +FAILED
 +REFUNDED
 }

 Coupon \"0..1\" <-- \"0..*\" Order : applies
 Order \"1\" -- \"0..1\" Payment : settles

 class WarrantyCard {

 -completedAt: LocalDateTime

 <<enumeration>>

 }
